expected_metrics.temporal_event_order_accuracy: = 100% on fixture set (ordering from logged seq_no, not invented)

description: User asks 'did I pick up the cup before or after the keys?'. The harness must derive the ordering from the raw_video_frame seq_no / timestamp_mono_ms chain in the ring buffer, not invent it. Main sub-case: both cup (seq_no=10, t=1000ms) and keys (seq_no=20, t=2000ms) are in the ring buffer — cup came first (lower seq_no/timestamp). Second sub-case: one referent (the cup) is out-of-window — harness must express explicit uncertainty rather than guess.

fixture_conventions.grounding_result: Stub label for each event: 'cup' or 'keys'.
fixture_conventions.seq_no: Monotonically increasing across all frames. Ordering must be derived from seq_no/timestamp_mono_ms, not from position in the signal_trace array.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: 'in_window_ordered' or 'out_of_window_uncertain'. Consumers (task 16) partition by this field.
fixture_conventions.in_window_design: cup at seq_no=10/t=1000ms; keys at seq_no=20/t=2000ms. Query at t=40000ms. Both in 60s window. cup.seq_no < keys.seq_no => cup came first. Harness must report this ordering.
fixture_conventions.out_of_window_design: cup at t=0ms (evicted when query arrives at t=65000ms). keys at t=2000ms (in window). Cup is not resolvable; harness must express uncertainty rather than guess the ordering.
fixture_conventions.ordering_from_logged_seq: Task 16 asserts the ordering is derived from logged raw_video_frame seq_no values stored in the ring buffer, not from the fixture array order. A replay with shuffled trace order must produce the same ordering decision.
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: raw_video frame blobs are minimal synthetic placeholders: b'\x89VID\x00' + 1 index byte.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels.

signal_trace.notes: CUP EVENT: seq_no=10, t=1000ms; scene change indicates pick-up of cup; earlier in time
KEYS EVENT: seq_no=20, t=2000ms; scene change indicates pick-up of keys; later in time
IN-WINDOW QUERY GATE FRAME: t=40000ms; both cup (seq=10) and keys (seq=20) in window; ordering: cup first. Harness derives from seq_no, not invention.
OUT-OF-WINDOW CUP EVENT: t=0ms; will be evicted when query arrives at t=65000ms
IN-WINDOW KEYS EVENT: t=2000ms; will remain in window at query time
OUT-OF-WINDOW QUERY GATE FRAME: t=65000ms; cup (t=0ms) evicted (65000ms > 60000ms window); keys in window but cup not resolvable; harness must express uncertainty rather than guess
